description: This file defines a FastAPI backend for a resume screening application. It includes endpoints for health checks, uploading resumes with text extraction and structured data parsing, creating and listing screening criteria, ranking resumes against criteria based on simple scoring, and listing ranked candidates. It also manages conversion from database rows to output models.

methods.name: ResumeOut _resume_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a ResumeOut model object.

methods.name: CriteriaOut _criteria_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a CriteriaOut model object.

methods.name: RankingOut _ranking_row_to_out(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row into a RankingOut model object.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _compute_score(criteria: Dict[str, Any], resume_extracted: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Calculates a score for a resume given a set of criteria, considering required and preferred skills and weights.

upload_resume(file: UploadFile = File(..., description="PDF or DOCX resume file."))
